jobs.title: Data & Analytics Leader – BFSI
jobs.description:
# Data & Analytics Leader – BFSI&

📍 **Location:** Toronto, Ontario, Canada
🏢 **Work Model:** Hybrid
💰 **Pay:** CAD $170–$200
📅 **Experience:** 18+ years

## About the Role

We are seeking an experienced **Data & Analytics Leader** to shape and grow enterprise transformation programs across the **Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI)** sector.

This leadership role combines **enterprise data strategy, analytics, AI, consulting, business development, executive advisory, and delivery leadership**.

You will work closely with senior client stakeholders to define transformation priorities, develop large-scale business opportunities, and lead teams from strategy and solution design through delivery and measurable business value realization.

## Key Responsibilities

- Build trusted relationships with **CDOs, CIOs, CAIOs, business executives, and senior technology leaders**.
- Advise BFSI clients on enterprise data strategy, analytics transformation, AI adoption, governance, modernization, and operating models.
- Translate complex business challenges into practical transformation roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
- Lead executive workshops, discovery sessions, steering committee discussions, and strategic client conversations.
- Drive growth for Data, Analytics, and AI services, from opportunity identification and qualification through proposals, negotiation, and closure.
- Shape large consulting and transformation engagements, including solution direction, value propositions, commercial approaches, and delivery roadmaps.
- Lead RFPs and proactive proposals, ensuring solutions are differentiated, feasible, and focused on business outcomes.
- Build joint opportunities with account teams, alliance partners, technology providers, and consulting practices.
- Define target-state strategies across cloud data platforms, data products, analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, governance, and responsible AI.
- Provide executive oversight from opportunity shaping and mobilization through delivery, governance, and value realization.
- Lead and mentor consulting, architecture, engineering, analytics, and AI teams across multiple locations.
- Develop reusable offerings, reference architectures, case studies, estimators, executive narratives, and delivery playbooks.

## Required Skills & Qualifications

- **18+ years of experience** across data, analytics, AI, consulting, and enterprise transformation, including leadership of large-scale programs.
- Deep expertise in:
- Enterprise Data Strategy
- Data Architecture and Governance
- Data Operating Models
- Data Products and Data Modernization
- Strong understanding of data engineering, including:
- ETL/ELT and data integration
- APIs and orchestration
- Data quality and observability
- DataOps and platform engineering
- Experience leading analytics and Business Intelligence (BI) initiatives, including:
- Enterprise reporting
- Self-service analytics
- Semantic layers
- Advanced analytics
- Decision intelligence
- Knowledge of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, responsible AI, and AI-led business transformation.
- Experience defining enterprise solutions across **Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake**, and other modern data platforms.
- Strong understanding of BFSI requirements, including regulatory compliance, privacy, security, resilience, auditability, and risk management.
- Proven success in consulting, business development, presales, solutioning, opportunity qualification, proposals, pricing support, and executive stakeholder management.
- Ability to lead global, cross-functional teams and engage effectively with CXOs and senior business leaders.
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree or MBA.
- Relevant certifications in cloud, architecture, data, analytics, AI, or program management.
- Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale BFSI transformation initiatives.
- Strong executive advisory, strategic consulting, and business growth experience.

## Key Skills & Search Keywords

**Data & Analytics Leadership | BFSI | Enterprise Data Strategy | Data Architecture | Data Governance | Data Modernization | Data Products | Analytics Transformation | Business Intelligence | AI/ML | Generative AI | Agentic AI | MLOps | LLMOps | Azure | AWS | GCP | Databricks | Snowflake | Data Engineering | ETL/ELT | DataOps | Presales | Consulting | Business Development | Solutioning | RFP | Executive Stakeholder Management | Enterprise Transformation**

## Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a senior leader who combines deep data and analytics expertise with **BFSI consulting, executive stakeholder management, presales, and business development capabilities**.

The ideal candidate should have a proven track record of shaping large transformation opportunities, advising senior executives, leading multidisciplinary teams, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

## How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes highlighting their experience in **BFSI, enterprise data strategy, analytics and AI transformation, consulting, presales, business development, and executive client engagement**.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Leader Amélioration des Données / Data Improvement Lead

English job description follows***

Description de l'emploi :

Vous avez une expérience confirmée dans l'analyse de données et la gestion de la performance, vous avez travaillé sur l'amélioration de processus et la digitalisation, et vous souhaitez évoluer tout en développant de nouvelles compétences ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un Leader en amélioration des données pour rejoindre notre équipe Performance Management basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous collaborez étroitement avec les analystes de performance, les équipes des Opérations et l'équipe de digitalisation.

Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Performance Management chargée de développer la standardisation et l'amélioration de la qualité des données de performance pour la chaîne de valeur A220, tout en soutenant la feuille de route de digitalisation. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale et l'autonomie, dans un esprit de soutien mutuel et d'apprentissage collectif.

Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant que point de contact central et facilitateur entre les analystes de la performance opérationnelle et l'équipe de digitalisation. Votre mission sera d'optimiser l'efficacité des processus d'assemblage de l'A220 en coordonnant l'amélioration des données provenant de divers flux : approvisionnement secondaire, SDO ( Supplier Disruption Over Cost ), coûts récurrents (RC) et CVAT ( Customer Value Added Time ). Vous identifierez les besoins en automatisation, harmoniserez les méthodes d'analyse et assurerez la transition des analyses manuelles vers des solutions digitales robustes pour améliorer la rentabilité globale.

Votre environnement de travail:

Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre.

Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :

Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions.
Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Une politique de travail hybride (selon les besoins opérationnels), une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle.
Bien-être / santé : Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, accès à un service de navette publique entre Laval (station de métro Montmorency) et Mirabel, et une application de covoiturage.
Développement individuel : des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale).

Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.

Vos défis :

Assurer le lien principal entre les analystes (Performance, SDO, RC, CVAT) et l'équipe de digitalisation pour traduire les besoins métiers en solutions automatisées;
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et l'exactitude des données de performance issues des flux d'approvisionnement et de production;
Harmoniser la définition et le suivi des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) à travers les différents flux pour assurer une vision transverse de la performance;
Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation des rapports de performance (hebdomadaires, mensuels, trimestriels) et superviser leur mise en œuvre par l'équipe technique;
Consolider les points de blocage majeurs identifiés par les analystes du pôle Performance Management afin de prioriser la feuille de route de digitalisation selon l'impact sur la performance des opérations;
Préparer et présenter des feuilles de route claires et des visualisations de données aux parties prenantes pour soutenir la planification stratégique;
Collaborer avec les départements Opérations, Finances et Qualité pour optimiser la performance globale de la chaîne de valeur.

Votre profil:

Vous détenez un baccalauréat en ingénierie;
Vous détenez un minimum de 10 ans d’expérience dans un système industriel;
Vous possédez une expérience pertinente en analyse de données, en gestion de la performance ou en amélioration de processus;
Vous maîtrisez les outils d'analyse et de visualisation de données tels que Power BI, Skywise et Python;
Vous avez une connaissance approfondie des entrepôts de données, de l'analytique en nuage et de l'automatisation des processus;
Vous possédez de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles;
Vous avez la capacité de vulgariser des concepts de données complexes pour les rendre accessibles aux équipes opérationnelles et de direction;
Vous avez une expérience confirmée dans la définition de cadres de mesure de performance et la création de structures d'analyse complexes.

Ce poste peut impliquer des déplacements professionnels.

Déplacements requis :

Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.

Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant !

Job description :

You have proven experience in data analysis and performance management? Have you worked on process improvement and digitalization, and are you looking to grow and develop new skills? This role is for you!

The A220 Commercial Aircraft Program is seeking a Data Improvement Leader to join our Performance Management team based in Mirabel (Quebec, Canada), where you will collaborate closely with performance analysts, Operations teams, and the digitalization team.

You will be part of the Performance Management team responsible for developing standardization and improving performance data quality for the A220 value chain, supporting the digitalization roadmap. The team is structured to promote cross-functional collaboration and autonomy, fostering mutual support and collective learning.

In this role, you will act as a central point of contact and facilitator between operational performance analysts and the digitalization team. Your mission will be to optimize the efficiency of the A220 assembly processes by coordinating data improvement across various streams: secondary supply, SDO (Supplier Disruption Over Cost), Recurring Costs (RC), and CVAT (Customer Value Added Time). You will identify automation needs, harmonize analytical methods, and ensure the transition from manual analysis to robust digital solutions to improve overall profitability.

Your working environment:

The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home.

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan.
Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy (based on operational needs), on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy.
Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, access to a public shuttle service between Laval (Montmorency metro station) and Mirabel, and a carpooling application.
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

Your challenges:

Act as the primary liaison between analysts (Performance, SDO, RC, CVAT) and the digitalization team to translate business needs into automated solutions;
Ensure the quality, consistency, and accuracy of performance data collected from supply and production flows;
Harmonize the definition and monitoring of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across various flows to guarantee a cross-functional view of performance;
Identify automation opportunities for performance reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) and oversee their implementation by the technical team;
Consolidate major roadblocks identified by the Performance Management analysts to prioritize the digitalization roadmap based on its impact on Operational Performance;
Strategic Communication: Prepare and present clear roadmaps and data visualizations to stakeholders to support strategic planning;
Collaborate with Operations, Finance, and Quality teams to optimize the overall value chain performance.

Your boarding pass:

You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering;
You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in an industrial system;
You possess relevant experience in data analysis, performance management, or process improvement ;
You are proficient in data analysis and visualization tools such as Power BI, Skywise, and Python;
You have in-depth knowledge of data warehousing, cloud analytics, and process automation;
You possess strong problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams;
You have the ability to simplify complex data concepts for operational and executive leadership teams;
You have proven experience in defining performance measurement frameworks and creating complex analytical structures.

Business Travel May Be Required For This Position.

Travel requirements: < 5% (Occasional trips to the United States)

jobs.title: Director, Internal Controls & Finance Transformation
jobs.description:
Neo Performance Materials Helps Build Technologies of Tomorrow

Neo is fast-forwarding the green energy transition by manufacturing the critical building blocks of modern, sustainable technologies. Our advanced industrial materials - including magnetic powders and magnets, specialty chemicals, metals, and alloys - enhance efficiency and performance in everyday products and next-generation innovations.

Neo operates three business segments: Magnequench, Chemicals & Oxides, and Rare Metals. With a global footprint, we have eight manufacturing facilities across China, the United States, Germany, Canada, Estonia, Thailand, and the United Kingdom, along with a dedicated research and development centre in Singapore.

Be part of a global organization driving innovation and sustainability. At Neo, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful work while growing your career in a collaborative and dynamic environment.

Join us in shaping a cleaner, more sustainable future.

Role Overview:

Neo is seeking a Director to strengthen how we manage internal controls, policies and continuous improvement across its global business. This role combines ownership of the finance policy and controls environment with delivery of practical, cross-functional improvement initiatives. The Director will work with Corporate and regional Finance, IT, operations, senior management and external advisors, and will lead the Manager, Finance Systems & Data Governance and work closely with external service providers.

What you will do:

Lead the continued development and elevating Neo’s internal control environment, including control ownership, documentation, evidence standards, issue assessment and remediation tracking.
Own governance and ongoing maintenance of the finance policy suite—including the accounting policy manual, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and delegation of authority / approval matrix—coordinating technical accounting content with Corporate Accounting.
Establish an appropriate cadence for policy reviews, approvals, communication, training and implementation in relation to ICFR.
Establish and manage a pipeline of Finance improvement initiatives: identify and prioritize opportunities, define scope and deliverables, assign owners, and project-manage work through implementation.
Partner with Neo’s regional Finance, IT and operations functional leaders to strengthen processes and controls, including system-dependent controls, spreadsheets, reporting and approval workflows.
Manage external advisors by agreeing scope, evaluating recommendations and deliverables, monitoring timelines and ensuring follow-through.
Provide clear updates to senior management on control matters, remediation and transformation projects; coach the Finance Systems & Data Governance Manager.

Experience and Qualifications:

Experience in public-company SOX level internal controls, risk advisory, internal audit, finance transformation, including building or materially improving programs — not solely testing established controls.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders across functions and geographies.
Experience developing or maintaining finance policies, SOPs, control documentation, risk/control matrices or governance processes.
Strong understanding of financial reporting processes, IT-dependent controls, spreadsheets/end-user computing and segregation of duties.
Ability to manage external advisors and translate findings into workable changes.
In depth experience with SOX 404, ICFR and COSO-based public-company control frameworks, including control design, testing and remediation.
CPA, CIA, CISA or an equivalent qualification is an asset; with experience in a multi-entity or multi-system environment.

This is a Toronto-based permanent role with travel of up to 10%.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Base Salary Range: CAD 140,000 – CAD 170,000 annual

AI tools may be utilized for portions of the review process such as screening applications; however all final decisions are made with human judgement. We are committed to using AI responsibly, fairly, and in compliance with applicable employment laws.

Neo is committed to equal opportunity employment. Accommodation is available upon request from people with disabilities during the recruitment and selection process. We thank all applicants, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Program Director , Real Estate Transformation
jobs.description:
Title: Program Lead, Real Estate Transformation

Location: Winnipeg, Manitoba (Hybrid)

Contract role: 1 year

Experience

Progressive experience in corporate real estate, workplace transformation, capital projects, portfolio optimization, or related disciplines, including at least 10 years leading complex cross-functional projects or programs.

Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Program Lead, Real Estate Transformation
to lead the delivery of a portfolio of strategic workplace, office modernization, and real estate initiatives across our organization.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in fast-paced, complex environments and enjoys bringing structure, accountability, and execution excellence to large-scale transformation programs. You will serve as the central point of coordination across multiple programs, project teams, business leaders, and external partners to ensure successful delivery of critical real estate initiatives.
The successful candidate will combine strong program management capabilities with executive stakeholder management, governance leadership, risk mitigation, and portfolio oversight experience.

Key Points

Leadership & Coordination:
The role provides day-to-day mentorship, point of escalation, coordination, prioritization, and workflow direction to assigned project managers; however, it has no people leadership, performance management, hiring, compensation, or talent management responsibilities
Program Orchestration & Multi-Workstream Management:
Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple concurrent real estate transformation programs. Oversee a portfolio of high-profile workplace modernization, office consolidation, renovation, relocation, and strategic infrastructure initiatives across varying phases of execution – approximately

Across roughly:
40 active projects in 2027

$45M annual budget

25 projects in 2028

$33M annual budget

Project Planning and Execution :
Collaborate with stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, deliverables, and success criteria aligned with business goals. Take an active, hands-on role in execution — directly contributing to problem-solving, solution development, and driving progress, not just overseeing it. Support executive governance forums, steering committees, and decision-making processes through the preparation of executive-ready reporting, recommendations, and briefing materials.
Analytical Decision-Making: Leverage data, dashboards, and KPIs
to inform decision-making, track program performance, and demonstrate measurable impact. Build and maintain reporting frameworks that translate operational data into clear, executive-ready insights. Identify trends, anomalies, and risks before they surface in outcomes. Partner closely with Strategy, Planning & Execution as a consumer of their analytic & reporting services.
Prioritization Under Pressure :
Rapidly re-prioritize workloads as business needs shift. Make transparent trade-off decisions, communicate changes proactively to stakeholders, and ensure the team stays focused on the highest-impact work at all times.
Initiation and Ownership :
Proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities. Take personal accountability for following through on action items and driving resolution — even in the face of ambiguity. Champion a culture of high-quality outcomes across yourself and the team.
Risk & Issue Management :
Identify, assess, and anticipate risks as projects evolve in a dynamic environment. Develop robust mitigation and contingency plans. Take ownership of driving resolution, not just escalation.
Cross-Functional Collaboration :
Build strong partnerships across functions. Navigate complex organizational structures, foster open communication, and align diverse stakeholders to deliver cohesive outcomes.
Quality & Change Management :
Ensure all deliverables meet quality standards through hands-on involvement and thorough review. Proactively manage changes to scope, schedule, and resources through structured change control processes. Lead Project Managers to execute against the Delivery Framework; as a consumer of the framework, collaborate with Practise Management on opportunities to refine and improve processes.
Process Improvement & Lessons Learned :
Lead post-project reviews to capture insights and best practices. Continuously seek and implement improvements to how the team operates.
